scope: Metallic Mg(0001) and surface-Ca substituted Mg(0001) in the user's water/OH corrosion study. No MgH2 surface, Mg2Ca, full protective film, NEB, AIMD, DOS or Bader sweep.
source_policy: The uploaded Ca-related archive contains initial metal slabs and templates only. Its structures are not substituted for the previously converged OH/water parents. No arbitrary OH geometry is claimed as a recovered source.

proposed_models.name: M0_OH_second_water_diss
proposed_models.operation: Move one H of the newly adsorbed intact water to a checked nearby adsorption site; do not delete or add atoms.

proposed_models.name: M1_OH_second_water_diss
proposed_models.operation: Matched site and atomic mapping to M0; preserve all atoms.

construction_gates: Verify actual endpoint electronic/ionic convergence and forces; record geometry SHA-256.
Match M0/M1 cells, surface adsorption motifs and metal-site mapping despite Ca element reordering.
Identify which O/H atoms constitute the original OH and the newly adsorbed water before moving H.
Check H-H, O-O and metal-adsorbate separations under periodic boundaries; do not force H2 formation.
Preserve metal count, surface-Ca position and bottom-layer constraints; compare real final coordination after optimization.
Audit actual smearing, spin, dipole correction and K mesh in parents and references before fixing new INCARs.
Any new physical settings require consistent reference recomputation; do not mix old and new bare energies.
execution_policy: Two second-water endpoints first; OH coverage candidates second. Separate branches; do not bind unrelated existing jobs. Retain originals and use new output directories. No remote job was submitted in this preparation attempt.
licensing: Do not publish or export POTCAR files. Only use authorized potentials inside the HPC account when execution is available.
